title: Claude Code v2.1.77 — Breaking Changes & claude-agent-sdk Migration
description: Evidence of a Claude Code release beyond v2.1.76 with two significant changes: (1) Breaking change removing deprecated Windows managed settings path at C:\ProgramData\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json in favor of C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json. (2) Legacy SDK entrypoint removed — migration to @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk required. The claude-agent-sdk formalization may be the public release of the SDK powering Claude Code agents as a standalone npm package. Additional: releasebot.io reports bug fixes for hangs, deadlocks, and remote control glitches. Version number not confirmed as v2.1.77 — needs verification from GitHub Releases.
redundancy_check: Not in registry. registry_updates_pending in versions.json covers v2.1.73–v2.1.76 features but not this. claude-agent-sdk is a new npm package distinct from existing Claude Code SDK patterns.
preliminary_score: NEEDS_INVESTIGATION — version not confirmed, claude-agent-sdk public release impact unclear
